params.formula: C = S_0 e^(-qT) N(d_1) - K e^(-rT) N(d_2); P = K e^(-rT) N(-d_2) - S_0 e^(-qT) N(-d_1); d_1 = (ln(S_0/K) + (r - q + 1/2 sigma^2) T)/(sigma sqrt T); d_2 = d_1 - sigma sqrt T

greeks.vega: S e^(-qT) phi(d_1) sqrt T -- per 1.00 of volatility
greeks.theta: -S e^(-qT) phi(d_1) sigma / (2 sqrt T) - w r K e^(-rT) N(w d_2) + w q S e^(-qT) N(w d_1) -- per year, d/dt at fixed S
greeks.rho: w K T e^(-rT) N(w d_2) -- per 1.00 of rate
greeks.dividend_rho: -w T S e^(-qT) N(w d_1) -- per 1.00 of yield
greeks.units: raw partials (the golden file's and T0's convention; owner's ruling Q2/a); desk scalings -- per vol point /100, per day /365, per basis point /10000 -- at display only

params.pde: Theta + 1/2 sigma^2 S^2 Gamma + r S Delta - r V = 0 (2.7), re-read as: theta cost + carry = -(gamma gain the price assumes)

bump_h_rel.why: central differences: truncation ~ h^2, round-off ~ eps/h (first) and eps/h^2 (second); the Gamma study below puts the second difference's best h near 1e-4 relative in double precision at these scales, not the 1e-2 a hand estimate suggests -- 3.5's subject

paths.as_in_2_7: exact GBM at n_fine steps, read on N; 2.7's seed was 20261101, mu = 0

cited_from_2_7.source: experiments/2_7_delta_hedging.json, scenarios vol_low / base / vol_high, per_N N = 4096, call.hedged_pnl_discounted and gamma_dt_mean (seed 20261101, 4000 paths)

desk_units.note: display scalings of the raw partials above; the oracle and the C++ carry the raw values

h_rel.why: central differences: truncation ~ h^2, round-off ~ eps/h (first) and eps/h^2 (second); the Gamma study below puts the second difference's best h near 1e-4 relative in double precision at these scales, not the 1e-2 a hand estimate suggests -- 3.5's subject

live.engine: BlackCalculator(forward, sigma sqrt T, discount); delta(spot), gamma(spot), vega(T), theta(spot, T), rho(T), dividendRho(T)

units.price: present value in the same currency units as spot and strike
units.vega: dV/dsigma, per 1.00 of volatility (NOT per volatility point)
units.theta: dV/dt, per year (negative for a long position that decays)
units.rho: dV/dr, per 1.00 of the continuously compounded rate (NOT per basis point)
units.dividend_rho: dV/dq, per 1.00 of the continuously compounded dividend yield

golden.tolerance_rule: Relative where the reference exceeds 1.0, absolute otherwise. The edge block is looser by construction, not by concession: see SCHEMA.md.

parity_greeks.identities: P - C = K e^(-rT) - S_0 e^(-qT), so Delta_P = Delta_C - e^(-qT), Gamma and vega equal, Theta_P - Theta_C = r K e^(-rT) - q S_0 e^(-qT), rho_P - rho_C = -K T e^(-rT), dq: + T S_0 e^(-qT)

desk_units.note: display scalings of the raw partials above; the oracle and the C++ carry the raw values

d6.units: raw partials: vega per 1.00 of sigma, Theta per year, rho per 1.00 of r; scale at display
